EXCEPTION_NOTE: Northwind Ltd does not exclude any Annex A control; all 93 are marked applicable in the demo SoA. The deviations below are risks formally accepted in the risk register, plus one control whose status is held at partial pending technical enforcement.

EXCEPTIONS.title: A.8.1 status held at "partially implemented" pending endpoint enforcement
EXCEPTIONS.rationale: The demo external audit found no technical block on non-compliant devices. Status set to partial while device management and conditional access are rolled out.

EXCEPTIONS.title: Segregation of duties for backup administration not implemented
EXCEPTIONS.rationale: The team is too small to separate backup administration from restore approval. Accepted as a risk with compensating log review.

EXCEPTIONS.title: Residual risk from privileged utility programs accepted
EXCEPTIONS.rationale: R-DEMO-12: L1 x C2 = 2. Admin tooling is covered by access control and monitoring already in place.

EXCEPTIONS.title: Residual risk from audit and assessment activity accepted
EXCEPTIONS.rationale: R-DEMO-13: L1 x C2 = 2. External auditors sign confidentiality agreements and are evaluated as suppliers.

EXCEPTIONS.title: Two document library sites left outside restricted search
EXCEPTIONS.validity: review with the next permission clean-up
EXCEPTIONS.rationale: R-DEMO-14: restricting search on these sites would break legitimate access patterns. Residual risk 2 x 2 = 4, accepted 2026-02-25.
